decision: Forgiving generic slow-trend exits whenever the causal score remains positive materially increases exposure but traps capital in stale campaigns and collapses wealth in all three fixed scopes. Do not search a neighboring score threshold.
next_root_cause: Single-stock winner gaps show some slow-trend exits still truncate major compounders, but score positivity is not sufficient proof that an owned campaign deserves continuation. Test actual funded campaign profitability as the endogenous ownership state instead.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed candidate TDD, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
